name: com.kinatraa.audiosystem
description: Dependency-free audio system: cue libraries, pooled AudioSources, music crossfades and playlists, channel volumes with optional AudioMixer, ducking, pluggable settings/save hooks, and editor tooling (library window, id picker, constants generator, runtime debugger).

samples.description: Scripts showing SFX, music crossfade, volume sliders and a custom settings store.
